problem.title: SuMa KITTI Odom seq 07 full: elevation correction ablation
problem.question: Ablation: does the KITTI +0.205 deg elevation correction (used by upstream KISS-ICP and CT-ICP) change SuMa? Whether the SuMa paper used it has not been checked, so the corrected variant is kept out of Table 6.

variants.label: dense_profile (Table 6 variant on seq 07, raw scans)
variants.note: Surfel-based mapping with constant-velocity prediction (no GT seed; anchor matches first GT pose).
variants.readability_note: Adds only boolean toggles on top of the stable CLI.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stays inside the stable CLI, but expands the toggle surface.
variants.decision_reason: Best combined benchmark score on the shared dataset and interface.

variants.label: dense_profile (Table 6 variant on seq 07, raw scans) + KITTI 0.205 deg elevation correction
variants.intent: Same variant with the HDL-64E +0.205 deg elevation correction applied to every scan before downsampling.
variants.note: Surfel-based mapping with constant-velocity prediction (no GT seed; anchor matches first GT pose).
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Close enough to the current default to keep as a live alternative.

variants.label: SuMa paper pipeline (rendered surfel model, projective frame-to-model ICP)
variants.intent: SuMaPaper on raw scans with the official default.xml values: 900 x 64 vertex/normal maps, model view rendered from active stable surfels, projective association with 2 m / 30 deg gates, Huber 0.5, Gauss-Newton with frame-to-frame fallback, surfel radius, stability log-odds and fusion (RSS 2018). No vertical-angle correction (the official KITTI reader applies none; it hurts here). No loop closure.
variants.note: SuMa paper pipeline (SuMaPaper: rendered surfel model, projective frame-to-model ICP, surfel stability and fusion per RSS 2018 / official default.xml); raw scans, no GT seed, no loop closure. frame-to-frame fallbacks=0
variants.readability_note: Adds only boolean toggles on top of the stable CLI.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stays inside the stable CLI, but expands the toggle surface.
variants.decision_reason: Useful for comparison, but not strong enough to replace the current default.

variants.label: SuMa paper pipeline, normalised model lookup + 0.22 deg correction
variants.intent: SuMaPaper with the bilinear model lookup normalised over valid texels (the official lookup blends empty texels in, a bias towards the sensor) and the 0.22 deg KITTI vertical-angle correction. Fixes the forward drift in the seq 02 corridors where the official lookup and the elevation bowl of raw scans bias the weakly constrained forward direction (see papers/suma/README.md).
variants.note: SuMa paper pipeline (SuMaPaper: rendered surfel model, projective frame-to-model ICP, surfel stability and fusion per RSS 2018 / official default.xml); raw scans, no GT seed, no loop closure. frame-to-frame fallbacks=0
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Useful for comparison, but not strong enough to replace the current default.
